title: Building a Personal Brand vs. a Business Brand
summary: ORANGE-L2-046: Building a Personal Brand vs. a Business Brand.
body: This ORANGE Level 2 lesson develops practical sales and marketing competency in Building a Personal Brand vs. a Business Brand. Learners should connect the concept to customer behaviour, positioning, acquisition economics, conversion, retention and measurable business outcomes. The objective is to make evidence-based marketing and sales decisions, distinguish useful metrics from vanity metrics, and apply ethical persuasion without manipulation. Examples should be adapted to the relevant market, customer segment and regulatory environment.
